title: perf(ui): the affected-test selector's verdict does each per-file step once
body:
Fixes #37830
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

用户无感:只影响仓库自己的测试选择脚本,开发者在拉取请求上跑界面测试时,这一条测试从约 3.6 秒降到约 2.3 秒。
属于持续集成稳定性:替车队解决一条测试在慢机器上偶发超时、让拉取请求无故变红的问题。
出错会怎样:若改坏,只会让测试选择结果变化,而本次已核对新旧结果逐字节一致;可直接撤回。
要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The live-tree case "a change to the imported path walker selects what a change to the selector itself does" timed out on a starved PR runner (15.8 s of the 15 s `testTimeout`). Measured locally before choosing a route: of the case's 3.6 s, about 2.3 s was the first full import-closure scan (inherent to the live tree) and the rest was per-verdict work outside the shared scan memo, dominated by two quadratic `toLowerCase` loops. Route taken: make the work smaller, not raise the timeout. `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`:

- `selectAffectedTests`: the `selectedTestFileCount` filter lowers each filter and each test path once instead of once per (file, filter) pair (about 0.3 s of every verdict on the live tree).
- `dedupeFilters`: same, lowered once per entry.
- `libraryReadsDisk(rawSource, rawSpecifiers?)`: the closure scan passes the specifiers it already read, so every scanned file is no longer regex-scanned twice. The parameter is optional and defaults to the old computation; the unit pins call it unchanged.
- `owningPackage` answers are memoised per verdict (asked of every file several times).

No assertion in the test changed; only its timing comment was extended.

## Tests

- Verdict equivalence, old module (`origin/main`) vs new, on the live tree: walker change, selector change, empty change, `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, `packages/components/src/index.ts`, all JSON-identical; plus a 200-case `dedupeFilters` fuzz with mixed-case overlapping filters, no difference.
- `select-affected-tests.test.ts`, 71/71 passed, three local runs after the change.

<details><summary>Case time, local (shared box, vitest verbose)</summary>

| | walker case | whole file `tests` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| before (`e69fa46d`) | 3566 ms | 9.87 s |
| after, run 1 | 2430 ms | 7.06 s |
| after, run 2 | 2336 ms | 7.42 s |
| after, run 3 | 2274 ms | 7.07 s |

Node phase split (three verdicts on one memo), before vs after: walker 2283-2599 -> 1580-1707 ms, selector 469-658 -> 190-223 ms, empty 659-756 -> 381-443 ms.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Margin arithmetic: the failing run took 15.8 s for a case then measuring 3.6-4.2 s locally, a slow-runner factor of about 3.8-4.4x. At 2.3 s that factor gives about 10 s against 15 s. No per-case timeout was added, because the work itself got smaller.
- The remaining cost is the first full scan of about 9,900 files, the live tree the case exists to read. Shrinking it would mean a smaller fixture, which weakens what the case asserts.

## PR CI readings (the card's acceptance)

Read from the Test UI shard log that runs `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`. This body is written once at creation, before any run exists, so the readings go in the dev report comment on the card and the seat carries them into this section.

## Verification

Read first: `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` around the `selectedTestFileCount` filter, then the `libraryReadsDisk` signature.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && npx vitest run --project unit --reporter=verbose scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`. Expected: 71 passed, with the walker case at about 2.3 s on an idle box.
